attBesluta.text: This is a great item to keep out at the lake!

Well I must say that straight out of the box I thought wow, good weighted tool, then I gave it a little lube, grabbed a piece of 40mm cabling and it’s really really hard to ratchet your way through. Longer arms on it would make life a lot easier, smaller cabling it’s a bit easier. And I’m not a small guy, so my excitement turned into something a bit sour.
Ottimo rapporto qualità prezzo, robusta e ben stabile. I bordi sono anche ben definiti. Facile il montaggio.

the shelf came as expected well packaged, and protected, after peeling off the protective film and assembling it I hanged it on the wall. The thing is sturdy, functional and looks good. All in all I highly recommend it to anyone looking for such a shelf
no more taken dirty stuff home after big cooks
